verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "10-day mission" (R2, R5, R6, R8, R9); "9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes" approx. 10 days (R3, R4); "approximately 10-day mission" (R10); "crewed flight test" throughout
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly describe it as a ~10-day crewed test mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "testing the Orion spacecraft" (R1); "check that the spacecraft can safely make the journey" (R2); "validate the Orion spacecraft's systems" (R3); "test flight of ... the Orion spacecraft" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported as validating/testing Orion in deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's SLS rocket in deep space.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "second flight of the Space Launch System (SLS)" (R3); "test flight of ... the SLS rocket" (R5); SLS separates early, Orion goes to deep space
verifications.reasoning: SLS is tested during launch/ascent, not in deep space; Orion is the deep space vehicle.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "life-support systems" (R3, R5); "keep its crew alive during trips to and from the moon" (R2); "validate the life-support systems" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states testing life-support in deep space with crew.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed mission around the moon in more than five decades" (R1); "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972" (R3); "first crewed lunar flyby in 50 years" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as first crewed lunar mission since Apollo ~50 years.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts ... around the moon" (R1); "four astronauts ... around the moon" (R2, R3); "fly four astronauts around the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm four astronauts on lunar flyby.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5); "evaluating life support ... systems" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Precisely matches stated objectives.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "life support and other critical spacecraft systems" (R3); "life-support systems" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Environmental control is part of life-support, but not explicitly named; broader term used.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "validate the Orion spacecraft's systems, crew operations, and mission procedures" (R3); manual piloting/navigation demos
verifications.reasoning: Systems testing includes navigation implicitly via demos, but not explicitly listed as key objective.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts including the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ms. Koch ... first woman to do so" (R2); "Christina Koch the first woman" (R3); "Koch will be the first woman to go to the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states Koch as first woman beyond LEO to Moon.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts including the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Glover ... first Black man to venture into deep space" (R2); "Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color" (R3); "Glover will be the first person of color to go to the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly identifies Glover as first person of color beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts including the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Hansen ... first person on a moon mission who is not an American" (R2); "Jeremy Hansen the first non-U.S. citizen" (R3); "Hansen will be the first Canadian to go to the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Confirms Hansen as first Canadian beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II journey around the Moon passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond it.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "about 4,000 miles above the surface" (R2); "Distance 4,067 mi" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Closest approach ~4,000-4,067 miles; 4,700 is rough approximation but slightly off.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "farthest that any humans have traveled from Earth" (R2, R3); "farther from Earth than any humans have traveled before" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly breaks distance record.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for the Artemis III, IV, and future missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "lay the groundwork for future exploration" (R1); "clear a path for more exploration" (R2); "supporting subsequent Artemis missions" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Positioned as test for later Artemis missions.

verifications.claim: The Artemis III, IV, and future missions will land humans back on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "returning humans to the moon" (R1); "new lunar landing" (R2); "returning humans to the lunar surface" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Program goals include landings on III/IV.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Reid Wiseman, the NASA astronaut who is the commander" (R2); "commander Reid Wiseman" (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: All crew lists confirm Wiseman as commander.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Victor Glover, who is scheduled to pilot" (R1); "Victor Glover, Pilot" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed as pilot.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Christina Koch" mission specialist (R2, R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Confirmed in all sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Jeremy Hansen" mission specialist (R2, R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Confirmed in all sources.
